findings.title: Address validation incomplete: execute() member-management path bypasses _VALID_ETH_ADDR
findings.description: The R6 fix added _VALID_ETH_ADDR validation to invite_member(), but execute() bypasses ACTIONS dispatch for invite_member/remove_member and runs its own _commit_transform logic. That path calls _es._norm_addr(intent['wallet']) which only lowercases the string, accepting any non-empty string as a wallet address.
findings.suggestion: Add _VALID_ETH_ADDR.match() before _norm_addr in execute()'s member-management branch.
